pages.text: Ore Bases are the primary output of the Akaishi Transformer, converting any ore into a standardized base that machines can recognize.$(br2)$(bold)The complete family:$(reset)$(li)Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Redstone, Lapis, Diamond, Emerald or Quartz (ore or deepslate) → the matching Ore Base$(li)Ancient Debris → Ancient Debris Base$(li)Compressed Akaishi Essence → Akaishi Ore Base (Akaishi Ore no longer converts directly; it must be pulverized into the concentrate first)$(li)Lapis Dust → Cooling Base (used by the cooling line, not by ores)$(br2)A single machine produces all of them: the Transformer, one input to one output.

$(bold)Uses:$(reset)$(li)Iron, Gold, Diamond and Ancient Debris Bases: the four Catalyst tiers$(li)Copper, Redstone and Lapis Bases: the Auto Collector upgrade line$(li)Coal Ore Base: Fuel Canner$(li)Nether Quartz Ore Base: Wireless Core and Fusion Insulation$(li)Emerald Ore Base: Life Centrifuge; Akaishi Ore Base: Chi Energy Assembly$(li)Cooling Base: the start of the heat-sink line (see Fuel & Cooling)$(br2)The base required by a recipe indicates the progression tier reached.
These bases are made by the $(l:akaishi:transformer)Transformer$(/l), whose feedstock such as Lapis Dust is covered in $(l:akaishi:dusts)Dusts$(/l).
